description: push_transaction_to_logs_direct reducer matches {:exit, {log_id, reason}} but real Task.async_stream exits are {:exit, reason} (e.g. {:exit, :timeout} with on_timeout: :kill_task) — would raise instead of counting a log failure. Also sequencer_notify_fn() typespec says arity-2 but all call sites use arity-4. Found in bedrock-9n6 audit.
title: Finalization log-push exit clause won't match real Task.async_stream exits; sequencer_notify_fn typespec arity
